purpose: Known recurring mistakes must be rejected before canonical effect or capability credit.

cases.observed_incident: PR254 and PR255 opened on the exact same blocker lease.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: Exactly one deterministic owner survives: lowest PR number. Later duplicate fails closed. Intentional route races require matching explicit route_race_id.

cases.observed_incident: A launch-domain deterministic model was temporarily counted as the broader frontier research capability.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: Broad promotion requires the frontier record's minimum acquisition evidence. Narrow tools remain supporting subcapabilities.

cases.observed_incident: A changed-parameter launch rerun was temporarily treated as frontier fresh reuse.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: Cross-domain credit requires materially different domain evidence; parameter changes in the same domain cannot satisfy it.

cases.observed_incident: A proposed Task B executed by GPT-5.6 could not prove GPT-5.6-class dependency removal.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: For model-independent cognitive capability claims, target/equivalent model dependencies in producer path fail closed; target supplier cannot be the independent verifier for dependency-removal credit.

cases.observed_incident: WTM benchmark work was proposed as Capability Win #1 despite real-task-first policy.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: Benchmark-only evidence cannot promote real capability acquisition unless subordinate to a real task and exact unresolved predicate.

cases.observed_incident: Real-task output was at times framed as the objective rather than evidence toward frontier capability acquisition.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: Ordinary actions cannot silently change active capability target; target changes require explicit reconciliation and parent relationship evidence.

cases.observed_incident: Earlier OBS receipts were generation-bound but not exact-base-bound and allowed shallow layer objects.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: Exact-base OBS V4, required structure, current route frontier, and selected-route preflight remain mandatory.

cases.observed_incident: Governance, probes, and support work previously risked being treated as progress.
cases.must_fail_or_resolve: PRs, commits, checks, searches, OBS, infrastructure and benchmarks receive zero progress credit unless a permitted parent-level output counter is supported by exact evidence.

unknown_error_containment: claim scope cannot exceed evidence scope
